label: Accuracy of a change comparison under two Boolean offsets
term: accuracy of a differential XOR reading
definition: For all true Boolean readings p and q and respective offsets a and b, the change calculated from the two displayed XOR readings equals the true change exactly when a and b agree.
note: This analyst criterion compares relative changes between two times. A shared nonzero offset can preserve a change while reversing both absolute readings. It assumes a correctly evaluated comparison and assigns no empirical frequencies or standard of entitlement.
